bells-of-steel-lat-pulldown-low-row-mach: Smooth lat pulldowns and rows, good for the price.
bowflex-selecttech-552: Fast dial and space-saving, used for years; the plastic feel irks.
concept2-bikeerg: Built like a tank and smooth; the stock seat is the main gripe.
concept2-rowerg: Lasts millions of metres with little upkeep; some chain noise.
concept2-skierg: Durable even in damp garages; takes time to learn, elbows may ache.
force-usa-c20: All-in-one rack, smooth cables and a solid Smith; the bench wobbles.
force-usa-compact-leg-press-hack-squat: Commercial feel in a small footprint; it needs many plates.
ironmaster-quick-lock-adjustable-dumbbel: Tank-like with a real dumbbell feel; weight changes are slow.
ironmaster-super-bench-pro-v2: Stable yet easy to move and store, with a useful leg attachment.
powerblock-elite-usa-90: Saves lots of space and money; some metal-on-metal clanking.
prx-profile-pro-squat-rack: Folds to the wall to free up room, yet feels solid and top quality.
rep-adonis-cable-tower: Smooth pulldowns and rows; a couple would upgrade seat or pulleys.
rep-arcadia-functional-trainer: Smooth cables for a corner; limited for pulldowns and rows.
rep-ares-2-0: Very smooth cables and solid build; the cables twist for some.
rep-athena-functional-trainer: Compact, smooth and space-saving; light stacks for one.
rep-black-diamond-power-bar: Grippy knurling that spares hands; some sleeve marring.
rep-blackwing-adjustable-bench: Very solid and stable, but heavy and hard to move.
rep-double-black-diamond-power-bar: Aggressive knurling owners love; too sharp for pressing for one.
rep-nighthawk-adjustable-bench: Solid, stable and easy to store; some want a steeper seat angle.
rep-open-trap-bar: Versatile for deadlifts, though large for a small gym.
rep-pr-4000: Solid and stable even unbolted; slight pull-up wobble in one setup.
rep-pr-5000: Very sturdy and a good base for add-ons; a couple got scratched parts.
rep-quickdraw-adjustable-dumbbells: Quick changes and a sturdy feel; bulky at heavier loads.
rep-strive-air-bike: Versatile for warm-ups, HIIT and long rides; tricky assembly.
rep-strive-curved-treadmill: Very solid with free-run and sled modes; some noise or bumping.
rep-x-pepin-fast-series-adjustable-dumbb: All-metal, quick and compact; plates stick in the cradle.
